hooks.command: bash -lc 'repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; repo_script="$repo_root/.codex/hooks/cross_cli_status.py"; home_script="$HOME/.codex/hooks/cross_cli_status.py"; if [ -x "$repo_script" ]; then HERMES_HOOK_CLI=codex HERMES_HOOK_EVENT=Stop exec "$repo_script"; elif [ -x "$home_script" ]; then HERMES_HOOK_CLI=codex HERMES_HOOK_EVENT=Stop exec "$home_script"; else echo "Missing cross_cli_status.py" >&2; exit 1; fi'
